L. 92–5, title I, §4(a)(2), Mar. 17, 1971, 85 Stat. 5 ] Section, act Aug. 16, 1954, ch. 736, 68A Stat. 777 , permitted the Secretary to receive Treasury bills, notes and certificates of indebtedness issued by the United States in payment of any internal revenue taxes or stamps.
